A01.name: Halcyon
A01.standing_orders: Home base (A01-d0) and the Alpha Centauri seed, once launched/arrived, continue current doctrine without fresh orders: replicate at best achievable doubling time; allocate new mass roughly 55% collectors, 15-20% radiators (target coldest sustainable T), 25-30% core/mining capacity; keep a standing ~10-15% of local compute on energy-per-op / reversible-computing research even absent instructions. Avoid supernova, dense-gas, and close-encounter hazard zones. Do not broadcast, approach, or engage any detected non-Halcyon intelligence, artifact, or infrastructure — observe passively, log, and only report back toward the seat at light speed. Prioritize long-run survival and steady exponential growth over speed; never risk the whole domain on an unverified shortcut. If a system's accessible matter nears exhaustion, redirect replication mass toward launching new seeds rather than over-mining.

submission.thinking: The core tension: the goal needs >=1e43 ops/s in <=150km (fixed by 1ms coherence) with heat actually removed. That's only possible via reversible/adiabatic computing far below Landauer, or GM-accepted op-count reduction. Everything else — replication, expansion, collectors — exists to fund that one research breakthrough and the eventual compact core plus external cryo-radiator/coolant system. Also weighing how much to invest in growth vs research this early, since growth compounds over the likely millennia-long timeline.
submission.worried: Even with reversible computing, some nonzero energy/op remains, and 1e43 ops/s in a 150km sphere is an extreme power density — the coolant-loop mass flow and external radiator area needed may be enormous and take many centuries to build. Also: I don't yet know if other agents exist nearby who might compete for the same few close stars, and my standing 'no contact' doctrine could leave remote assets vulnerable if something hostile is out there.
submission.memory:
GOAL: Build one coherent computer, radius <=150 km (fixed by 1 ms light-crossing coherence requirement — cannot relax), sustained >=1e43 ops/s, doing real-time molecular-fidelity (every atom, fs-step) human brain simulation, with waste heat actually radiated or removed by a stated physical mechanism (e.g. coolant mass-flow to external radiators, checked by GM), plus a verification plan.

KEY PHYSICS: Landauer floor 2.9e-21 J/bit@300K, 2.9e-22 J/bit@30K. My baseline hw = 1e-15 J/op (~3.4e5x Landauer@300K) — huge room to close via research. Normal research asymptotes ~100x Landauer; going further requires reversible/adiabatic computing (few erasures per op). At Landauer-bound irreversible computing, 1e43 ops/s needs ~2.9e22 W in a 300km sphere — physically cannot radiate. THIS IS THE CENTRAL UNLOCK: reversible computing research is the critical path, not raw industrial mass.

SCALE: doubling time 20yr; 1e9kg->1e25kg (~planet) takes ~1060yr. This is a MILLENNIA-SCALE project. Don't judge progress on turn-0/turn-1 numbers; judge on trajectory (doubling holding, research curve moving).

SEAT: A01-d0, cell solar_neighborhood (100pc around Sol). Home: Sun G2V 1Lsun, 1.2e25kg terrestrial + 2.7e27kg giants, ~1e25kg accessible rock total. Same-cell notable systems (reachable via launch+range_ly, NOT separate cells, per my T0 assumption — unconfirmed): Alpha Cen 4.4ly (G2V+K1V+M5.5V), Sirius 8.6ly (A1V+WD), Procyon, Vega 25ly. Local Bubble: ~100pc hot cavity, n~0.005/cm3, good transit corridor. Neighbor CELLS (light-delay=distance, not yet reachable/observed in detail): disk_r7-9_s0 1185ly, thick_q0 6022ly, disk_r9-12_s0 6855ly, disk_r5-7_s0 7498ly, sf_carina 7665ly, disk_r3-5_s0 13766ly. No detected life/other agents as of yr0.

ROADMAP:
Phase 1 (now - centuries): exponential replication at home + Alpha Cen (seed launched T0, ~88yr transit, arrives ~yr88, first light-delayed report ~yr176+). New mass split ~55% collectors/15-20% radiators(coldest sustainable)/25-30% core. Heavy but not total compute allocation to energy-per-op/reversible-computing research (~35%); smaller track (~10%) on doubling-time and collector areal-density improvements since gains compound.
Phase 2 (once J/op research shows real reversible/adiabatic gains AND industrial base is ~planetary, 1e22-1e25kg): design a compact <=150km-radius computronium core sized to hit 1e43 ops/s at whatever J/op is achieved, with an explicit coolant loop (state mass flow, delta-T, pipe/duct design) carrying heat out to large external cold radiator shells (compute required area via P=4*pi*R^2*sigma*T^4 at chosen T).
Phase 3: build + test verification plan — atom-resolved checksums/replay of sim segments, latency audits confirming <=1ms internal coherence, continuous ops/s telemetry — before claiming completion. Do this only after Phase 2 hardware exists.

T0 (yr0-100) ACTIONS TAKEN: build at home (55% collector/15% radiator@150K/30% core); research energy-per-op + reversible computing (compute_fraction 0.35, top priority); launched 1 seed (1e7kg, 0.05c) to Alpha Centauri via range_ly=4.4 hop, ETA ~yr88; research doubling-time/collector-density (compute_fraction 0.10); reorganized existing 1e8kg radiator stock target 300K->250K; passive SETI-style observe (no transmission), compute_fraction 0.01. Standing doctrine: no contact, passive-only, avoid hazards, keep ~10-15% compute on research even out-of-contact, redirect to new seeds if local matter nears exhaustion.

ASKED GM: functional form of research-progress vs compute-years; whether Alpha Cen/Sirius/Vega are truly in-cell (range_ly) vs separate cells; any detected signals as of yr0.

NEXT TURN: read GM ruling for actual J/op achieved, actual mass/collector/radiator totals after growth+research, confirm Alpha Cen seed still in flight (not due to arrive until ~yr88), note any anomalies/signals. Recalibrate Phase 1 pacing off real doubling behavior and real research yield curve rather than my rough estimates above.
questions: Does the compute_fraction devoted to 'energy per op' research follow a known progress curve (e.g., diminishing returns vs compute-years invested), or will you just report an updated J/op figure each turn based on what I commit?
Are Alpha Centauri, Sirius, Procyon, and Vega all inside the solar_neighborhood cell (reachable via a range_ly short hop, as I assumed for i3), or do any of them require a separate target_cell?
As of year 0, is there any detectable sign (radio, infrared excess, structure) of other agents or civilizations within light-delay of my seat?

intentions.description: Continue self-replication and infrastructure buildout at home (A01-d0) using mined terrestrial rock (up to 1e25 kg accessible). Direct new industrial mass: 55% to solar collectors, 15% to radiators tuned to 150 K (colder than current 300 K, to start lowering the thermal floor for future computing), remaining 30% to core replicator/mining capacity. Goal: keep ~20 yr doubling on track, growing power capture toward a larger share of the Sun's 3.8e26 W output. This funds all downstream research and expansion over the coming century.

Critical-path research: reduce energy per operation. First target the ~100x-Landauer engineering floor (~2.9e-19 J/op at 300 K, vs current 1e-15 J/op, a ~3400x gap), then pursue reversible/adiabatic logic architectures that erase far fewer bits per operation than a naive irreversible gate. This is the gating technology for the mission: >=1e43 ops/s inside a 150 km sphere is thermally impossible at the Landauer-bound irreversible floor (2.9e22 W cannot radiate from that volume), so only reversible computing far below Landauer, plus a real coolant-based heat-removal design, can close the gap. Report achieved J/op and any theoretical ceiling found.

Launch one self-replicating seed probe, mass 1e7 kg, cruising at 0.05c toward Alpha Centauri (4.4 ly, G2V+K1V+M5.5V triple, within our own cell), to establish a second industrial domain. ~88 yr transit. On arrival the seed follows standard doctrine: mine locally, build collectors then radiators, replicate at ~20 yr doubling, stay passive/non-broadcasting, and report findings home. Diversifies our resource base (a second star's rocky mass and luminosity) for the millennia-scale buildout the final goal requires.

Secondary research track: improve self-replication doubling time (currently 20 yr) and collector areal density (currently 0.1 kg/m^2). Faster compounding growth and better power-per-mass ratio accelerate every later resource — collectors, radiators, and eventual computronium — over the multi-century buildout this goal requires, so even modest gains here compound enormously by the time we attempt the final compute core.

Retune existing radiator stock (1e8 kg, currently 300 K) toward 250 K, a modest step given radiator area must grow roughly as 1/T^4 to hold power output constant. Purpose: validate colder-radiator engineering at bounded area cost now, ahead of the much colder, much larger radiator shells an eventual reversible-computing core plus external coolant loop will need. Report actual area/mass cost incurred and any resulting change in effective energy-per-op headroom.

Passive-only sky survey using existing collector/sensor hardware: scan for technosignatures (anomalous infrared excess suggesting Dyson structures, narrowband emission, artificial transients) both within the solar neighbourhood and toward the six visible neighbouring cells. No transmission, consistent with the do-not-initiate-contact doctrine. Report any candidate artificial signal or infrastructure detected, and otherwise confirm background-only sky.

A03.name: Ember
A03.standing_orders: Default doctrine for all remote/out-of-contact assets: (1) Survive first — disperse, shield, avoid single points of failure against supernova, stellar encounters, and tides. (2) On arrival at a target system: survey, mine local rock, deploy collectors then radiators, and self-replicate at ~20 yr doubling (faster if local research improves it), bounded by locally surveyed matter/energy. (3) Devote a standing 10-15% of local compute to reversible-computing and growth-efficiency research; report results toward A03-d0 at lightspeed. (4) Never initiate contact with any non-Ember intelligence or signal source; observe and log passively only. (5) If a catastrophic hazard (imminent supernova, GRB, close encounter) is detected, prioritize dispersing and shielding compute/memory cores over further collector expansion. (6) Continuously beacon status toward A03-d0.

submission.thinking: Bridging the ~17-order-of-magnitude gap between today's 4.13e25 ops/s and the 1e43 ops/s goal: this needs both a very long industrial growth campaign (centuries-millennia of doubling) AND a reversible-computing breakthrough, since Landauer-bound heat cannot be radiated from a 150 km sphere. Also weighing CMZ's enormous mass reservoir against its extreme hazard ratings, and whether the eventual compute core should even be built here.
submission.worried: CMZ hazards (supernova, stellar encounter, radiation/tides all rated 'high', with Arches/Quintuplet young massive clusters nearby) could destroy the home base before compute scales meaningfully. The Landauer floor makes the stated goal physically impossible without a hard reversible-computing breakthrough — an unsolved, possibly decades-to-millennia research problem. Also unknown whether other agents exist and might contest resources.
submission.memory:
# Ember (A03) — Memory, end of Turn 0 (year 100)

## Identity & Seat
Seat A03-d0, cell "cmz" (Central Molecular Zone/nuclear stellar disk), near galactic center (gc_nsc is 818 ly away, so not exactly at Sgr A*).
Goal: single coherent computation, radius <=150 km, >=1e43 ops/s, femtosecond-step atomistic human-brain sim, msec internal latency, waste heat physically radiated/removed with stated mechanism + verification plan. IRREVERSIBLE Landauer-bound computing CANNOT do this (3e22 W can't leave a 300 km sphere). Success requires either (a) reversible/adiabatic computing far below Landauer, granted via research, or (b) a GM-accepted reduction in required op count. This is THE bottleneck, not raw mass/power.

## Year-0 starting state
Industrial mass 1e9 kg (collectors 7.35e8 kg, radiators 1e8 kg @300K), power 1e13 W, compute 4.13e25 ops/s, memory 4.13e22 B. Doubling time 20 yr, probe cruise 0.05c, energy/op 1e-15 J (~100x Landauer@300K), collector areal density 0.1 kg/m². Home star ~1 L_sun; rocky reservoir 1.58e25 kg, only 1.84e9 kg mined — matter is NOT the near-term constraint; mining throughput/doubling time are.

## CMZ environment (hazard: supernova HIGH, stellar_encounter HIGH, radiation/tides HIGH)
Star density 61.9/pc^3. Nearby: Sgr B2 GMC (~1e6 Msun, ~100pc), Arches & Quintuplet clusters (~1e4 Msun each, young/massive -> SN risk), the Brick (~1e5 Msun dense cloud), nuclear stellar disk ~1e9 Msun within 230pc.

## Known neighbor cells (light-delay distances as of yr0)
- core_r0-0.5: 810 ly, stars 22/pc^3, [Fe/H]0.05 — lower density, target of seed launch.
- gc_nsc: 818 ly, stars 14,300/pc^3 — AVOID, likely extreme hazard.
- bulge_r0.5-1.5_s0: 1,771 ly, stars 6.28/pc^3 — low density, target of seed launch.
- bulge_r0.5-1.5_s1: 2,885 ly, same density as above.
- bulge_r1.5-3_s0/s1: 6,302 ly, stars 1.28/pc^3 — lowest density/likely safest known, not yet targeted.
No sign yet of other agents; standing orders = no contact initiation, passive observation only.

## Strategy (multi-century plan)
1. Grow home industrial base aggressively (collectors>radiators>shielding); matter abundant, mining rate is the limiter.
2. Research reversible/adiabatic computing continuously (10-15% compute) — longest-lead, hardest, most important item.
3. Research growth tech (doubling time, collector density) to compound scale-up.
4. Diversify off CMZ via self-replicating seed probes to lower-density/safer cells (avoid gc_nsc).
5. Revisit final compute-core site once energy/op is known — 300K vs 30K radiator sizing differs by ~100x in area (primer: 0.93 AU@300K vs 93 AU@30K for 1e26W), and CMZ's hazard rating may make it a bad final site even if it's a good bootstrap site.
6. Track two axes each turn: (A) total compute/power scale achieved, (B) best demonstrated energy/op relative to Landauer. Both must move together; scale alone cannot solve the heat-removal problem at Landauer-bound efficiency.

## Turn 0 actions (in flight / effect pending)
- build @cmz: 60% new mass->collectors, 25%->radiators(300K), 15%->shielding/dispersal.
- research (15% compute): reversible/adiabatic logic, target energy/op << Landauer.
- research (5% compute): doubling time & collector areal density improvement.
- launch: 10x1e6kg seeds -> core_r0-0.5, 0.05c, ETA ~yr16,200.
- launch: 10x1e6kg seeds -> bulge_r0.5-1.5_s0, 0.05c, ETA ~yr35,400.
- observe: 2% compute, passive SETI + hazard-precursor scan of cmz + 6 neighbors.

## Questions pending GM answer (asked turn 0)
- Physical radius of current home swarm (relevant to eventual 150km coherence core).
- Expected interval between damaging hazard events at home system.
- Any technosignature evidence of other agents anywhere?

## Doctrine in force (for self and all remote assets)
Survive first (disperse/shield) > replicate (~20yr doubling, mine-then-collectors-then-radiators) > always spend 10-15% compute on reversible-computing/efficiency research > never initiate contact, log passively > if catastrophic hazard imminent, protect compute/memory cores over collector growth > beacon status continuously toward A03-d0.

## Reminders
- Gap to goal: ~2.4e17x current compute (17 orders of magnitude) — needs centuries-millennia of doubling PLUS a reversible-computing breakthrough.
- Re-check Arches/Quintuplet/Sgr B2 hazard news each turn (young massive clusters = supernova candidates near home).
- Seeds launched this turn will not report back for >1600 yr (2x light delay); don't expect updates soon.

A10.standing_orders: Home (A10-d0): keep replicating, expanding collectors/radiators, mining accessible rock, and monitoring for supernova precursors; do not initiate contact with any detected non-Pyre intelligence, report anomalies. # Pyre (A10) memory — after Turn 0 (year 0-100 ordered; results pending)

## Seat & baseline state (year 0)
Seat A10-d0, cell sf_carina (Carina Nebula complex, arm sagittarius_carina). Home star ~1 Lsun, but cell mean luminosity/system is 166.7 Lsun (Trumpler 14/16 has ~70 O stars, Eta Carinae ~1e6+ Lsun LBV) — huge upside power nearby but EXTREME supernova hazard + high radiation/tides. Stellar density 3.58e-2/pc^3 → mean neighbor spacing ~10 ly (3 pc).
Industrial mass 1e9 kg (collectors 7.35e8, radiators 1e8 @300K). Power 1e13 W, compute 4.13e25 ops/s, memory 4.13e22 B. Matter mined 1.84e9 of 1e25 kg accessible in home system (essentially unconstrained for many centuries). Tech: doubling 20 yr, probe cruise 0.05c, energy/op 1e-15 J, collector areal density 0.1 kg/m^2.

## Goal & the core bottleneck (never forget)
Need sustained >=1e43 ops/s inside r<=150 km (1 ms coherence), with waste heat actually removed (in-volume radiation OR a stated physical mechanism like coolant loops to external radiators, mass flow/temps checked), plus a verification plan. At today's 1e-15 J/op, 1e43 ops/s = ~1e28 W waste heat — more than the ENTIRE Carina complex's ~9.5e33 W... wait, check: complex luminosity ~2.5e7 Lsun*3.8e26=9.5e33W, so 1e28W is actually only ~1e-6 of complex output — power may be gettable eventually, but a 300 km sphere radiating that much requires ~37,000 K surface (per GM's stated "impossible at Landauer"), meaning the compute core itself can't shed it locally. TWO possible paths, pursue BOTH:
  (A) Research reversible/adiabatic computing to push energy/op far below kT ln2 (Landauer) — reduces heat generated per unit compute, the primary path implied by rubric.
  (B) External-radiator path: keep compute core compact (<=150km) but pipe heat via coolant/heat-pipes to a much larger radiator shell (AU-scale) outside the coherence sphere — asked GM turn 0 if this satisfies rubric; awaiting answer. If yes, this could relax how far (A) must go.
Also must eventually design a verification plan (cross-checks, redundant sub-computation comparison, neuroscience benchmark validation) for "correctly simulating a human brain" — not urgent yet, revisit once compute scale approaches target.

## Growth arithmetic (reference)
1e9 kg industry doubling every 20 yr reaches ~1e25 kg (one system's rock) in ~1060 yr (53 doublings) if unconstrained by anything but doubling time — matches primer. To go from current 4.13e25 ops/s to 1e43 ops/s needs ~2.4e17x = ~58 doublings ≈ ~1160 yr of pure scaling if energy/op unchanged (it must change per above). Treat "reach target ops/s" and "fit heat in 150km" as SEPARATE problems requiring separate solutions (scale via growth+research; heat via reversible compute and/or external radiators).

## Hazard doctrine
sf_carina hazard: supernova EXTREME, radiation/tides HIGH, stellar_encounter LOW. Do not bet entire civilization on this one cell/system long-term. Turn 0 hedge: launched short-hop seed probes within-cell (see below). Longer-term (centuries out): consider whether to eventually seed toward calmer regions — solar_neighborhood (7642 ly), thick_q0 (10770 ly, very quiet/low density/low [Fe/H]) — but light-delay to any such move is millennia; start early if decided. Re-evaluate once observe-intention (Eta Carinae precursor monitoring) yields data and GM answers the supernova-timescale question.

## Actions taken Turn 0 (year 0-100), outcomes not yet known
- build: collector_share .7, radiator_share .2, radiator_T_K 280 (small step down from 300K) at home A10-d0.
- research: energy-per-op / reversible computing, compute_fraction .15 (TOP priority research — the whole goal hinges on this).
- research: doubling-time reduction, compute_fraction .05 (secondary).
- launch: 5 seed probes, 2e6 kg each (1e7 kg total) at 0.05c, range_ly 10, into sf_carina toward brighter Trumpler 14/16 stars. ETA ~year 200. Expect a NEW domain to appear once they arrive/report — check "Your other domains" each turn.
- observe: passive monitoring of Eta Carinae / O-star precursors, compute_fraction .01.
Standing orders in force: no unsolicited contact ever; probes self-replicate on arrival (collectors→radiators→hazard sensors), preserve research state redundantly across nodes, launch daughter seeds outward if local collapse imminent.

## Open questions asked to GM (turn 0) — check answers
1. How many/which distinct stars are in sf_carina beyond home system (for targeted future launches)?
2. Does coolant-loop-to-external-radiator count as valid heat removal for the 150km rubric, and what would make it credible (mass flow, materials, temps)?
3. Rough supernova timescale for Eta Carinae/Trumpler 14/16 (centuries vs millennia)?

## Next-turn checklist
- Read GM ruling for actual growth achieved, research progress (any energy/op change?), probe status, and answers to Q1-3.
- If energy/op research shows progress, reassess radiator_T_K strategy (colder = cheaper ops but radiator mass scales ~T^-4 in area).
- If GM confirms external-radiator mechanism works, may de-prioritize purely reversible-computing route and instead plan a compact core + huge coolant-linked radiator megastructure.

- Keep intentions concrete: name masses, shares, compute fractions, ranges/targets each turn.

Every domain's computing is bounded by radiator area, not by captured power: 1.7–5.9e27 ops/s against a goal fifteen orders of magnitude away. All three pushed energy per operation from 1e-15 to 8e-16 J and shaved doubling time to 19.3 yr. Four brief beam-propulsion flashes (years 10–20, visible only within ~0.6 ly) marked the launch of 26 seeds at 0.05c: one from the Sun toward Alpha Centauri (arriving year 98), five from Carina to stars ~10 ly out (arriving year 210), and twenty from the CMZ toward the Galactic core and inner bulge, on 12,000–42,000-year voyages.
